description: Delete a custom field by ID. Reach is workspace-wide: it disappears from every project, with the values entered for it, and this cannot be undone. To remove it from one project only, edit `projects_codes` with qase_custom_field_upsert. Asks the user for confirmation first. Cost: one API call, about 0.4s.
name: qase_custom_field_delete
title: Delete custom field
